messages:
Ana (Partnerships): Kicking off SGC (Singapore) marketplace + edge SKU gating with EdgeGrid (hw) and NimbusSI (SI). Goal: private preview beta 2026-06-01. Need quota, marketplace entitlement, KMS/HSM flow, and legal signoff. Mike — can you confirm capacity?

Mike (Cloud Ops): Can confirm EquatorCloud sg1 can provision up to 16 A100 GPUs for reserved capacity. Need marketplace entitlement enabled so reserved nodes appear for customers. I'll open a partner quota ticket today. ETA ~3 business days.

Ken (Partner PM): EdgeGrid requires an HSM/KMS integration doc and cross-account role example. Will draft onboarding doc and sample policies. Also need a checklist for marketplace SKU metadata.

Sarah (Legal): Heads up — we'll need a DPA update for SG region and an audit clause for KMS cross-account access. I sent the SOW template to Ken. I'll review EdgeGrid's vendor questionnaire when they send it.

Devon (Infra): A couple infra questions: do we want a single SKU or variant per HW profile? For autoscaling we need metadata: min_replicas, max_replicas, and a billing tag. Propose SKU id pattern: `redwood-sg-edge-a100-16`. Also need firewall + peering notes.

Julia (Sales): We have 8 APAC early customers asking for SG private preview invites. Sales needs a firm commit on quota and timeline by 2026-05-20 to start invites.

Ana (Partnerships): Action items I hear: 1) Mike open quota/entitlement ticket; 2) Ken provide onboarding + KMS playbook; 3) Sarah redline DPA + audit clause; 4) Devon produce SKU metadata + peering/firewall config; 5) Julia collate invite list. I'll coordinate partner comms and calendar.

Mike (Cloud Ops): Ticket created: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OPS-4982 — request: 16x A100 reserved in sg1 + marketplace entitlement. Linked to partner: EdgeGrid. Tagging @cloud-partners.

deploy-bot: Automatic: marketplace draft created by ken-edgegrid at 2026-04-12T09:12Z — draft id mkt-312-sg.

Ken (Partner PM): Uploaded onboarding draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/edgegrid-onboard-sg1 (will add KMS steps and role policy tonight). Pinging NimbusSI for joint integration plan — Ken -> @NimbusSI.

Sarah (Legal): Quick note: 2 blockers right now — (1) DPA updates ok; (2) KMS cross-account access requires explicit audit and key-rotation language. I will send redlines by EOD Friday.

Devon (Infra): Infra-security: peering/firewall needs 10.44.0.0/22 allowed between sg1 and our peering subnet. Also SKU metadata example for marketplace (please paste into listing):
```
{
  "sku_id": "redwood-sg-edge-a100-16",
  "region": "sg1",
  "hw_type": "a100",
  "reserved_count": "16",
  "billing_tags": "region:sg1,hw:a100,reserved:true"
}
```

Julia (Sales): :thumbsup: If OPS-4982 lands and legal redlines are done by 5/20 we can send invites the same week. Sales will prep customer comms.

Ana (Partnerships): Thanks — I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs 10:00 SGT and include EdgeGrid and NimbusSI. Will update the doc with owners and deadlines.

Mike (Cloud Ops): Noted. I'll update OPS-4982 with ETA once EquatorCloud confirms the placement group.

Ken (Partner PM): Will share updated onboarding doc + sample IAM JSON before the sync.

Sarah (Legal): I'll include the DPA redline link in the calendar invite.

Devon (Infra): Adding infra-security as watcher on OPS-4982.

Ana (Partnerships): Great. Leaving this thread open for quick updates; ping me for any blocker. :party-parrot:
